results.title: Will your check book change? Old check book closed from January 1? RBI gave final answer - this message is fake
results.description: RBI has termed the viral claim of closure of old check book and implementation of new check book from January 1, 2027 as fake. Account holders do not need to go to the bank to get the check book changed.
